records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Product revenue accounted for 43% of our consolidated revenue for the three months ended March 31, 2024, as compared to 56% for the three months ended March 31, 2023.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The Company’s continued execution delivered solid results during the first quarter of 2024, driven by the demand for our memory interface chips and our Silicon IP solutions, and continued stability from our royalties revenue.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Changes in operating assets and liabilities for the three months ended March 31, 2024 primarily included decreases in unbilled receivables and prepaids and other current assets, as well as increases in income taxes payable and accounts payable, offset by increases in inventories, accounts receivable, and decreases in accrued salaries and benefits and other liabilities.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Cost of product revenue decreased approximately $6.4 million for the three months ended March 31, 2024 as compared to the same period in 2023, primarily due to lower product revenue and a change in product mix.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Cash provided by operating activities of $39.1 million for the three months ended March 31, 2024, was primarily attributable to the cash generated from customer licensing, product sales and engineering services fees.
